falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 cash index closes at least 4% below its lowest close of the prior 20 sessions on the same day the VIX closes above 25.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A fresh equity low with a fear spike breaks the bottom_2024_aug analogue and shows the HOLD/UNKNOWN call missed an active risk-off breakdown.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 cash index closes at least 6% above its highest close of the prior 20 sessions while the NYSE cumulative advance-decline line makes a new 20-session high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breadth-confirmed upside break resolves the tape bullishly, so an unresolved HOLD/UNKNOWN verdict is no longer tenable.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 75 basis points or more from the window's starting level, or the engine blowoff score prints at or above 70.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either credit stress or a melt-up acceleration invalidates the moderate blowoff reading of 39 and the stable unknown/hold regime.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
